features.name: debt_to_income_ratio
features.description: Ratio of loan amount to annual income, normalized by log transformation to reduce skew. Measures borrower's debt burden relative to earnings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct linear signal for creditworthiness; higher ratio indicates greater repayment risk for SVM margin separation

features.name: credit_score_normalized
features.description: Credit score linearly normalized to [0,1] range using training set min (418) and max (807) values for smooth SVM input.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized credit quality signal directly usable by linear SVM without scaling artifacts

features.name: monthly_payment_burden
features.description: Estimated monthly loan payment as fraction of monthly income, combining interest rate effect with loan percent income.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures affordability stress; continuous severity measure well-suited for linear margin boundaries

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Composite score combining credit score, employment experience, and credit history length into a weighted stability index normalized to [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Weighted composite captures multiple stability dimensions in a single smooth feature for linear SVM

features.name: log_income
features.description: Log-transformed personal income to reduce right skew and create approximately linear relationship with loan approval likelihood.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes income distribution for SVM; removes extreme outlier influence while preserving ordinal information

features.name: interest_rate_risk_score
features.description: Normalized interest rate deviation from minimum observed rate (5.42), scaled by range to measure relative rate risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous risk measure; higher interest rates correlate with higher-risk borrowers, useful for linear separation

features.name: default_credit_interaction
features.description: Interaction between default history and credit score deviation from mean (633). Captures how defaults compound with poor credit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear interaction between default status and credit quality as a linear feature for SVM

features.name: homeownership_stability_index
features.description: Weighted homeownership stability score: mortgage=0.8, own=1.0, rent=0.3, other=0.1, reflecting housing stability levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts categorical homeownership into ordinal stability signal for linear SVM margin computation
features.formula: 0.8 * home_mortgage + 1.0 * home_own + 0.3 * home_rent + 0.1 * home_other + 0.1 * (1 - home_mortgage - home_own - home_rent - home_other)

features.name: loan_size_to_income_log_ratio
features.description: Log ratio of loan amount to income, providing a scale-invariant measure of loan size relative to earning capacity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scale-invariant debt burden measure; log transformation creates smooth continuous feature for linear SVM

features.name: education_income_alignment
features.description: Measures alignment between education level and income relative to training mean income (80865), indicating whether income matches educational attainment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures socioeconomic consistency signal; misalignment may indicate income instability relevant for loan risk

features.name: borrower_risk_composite
features.description: Holistic semantic assessment of borrower risk combining age-income stability, employment history, and loan purpose risk. Young borrowers with high debt, short employment, and risky loan intents score higher. Scale: 0=very low risk, 1=very high risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Semantic composite captures domain knowledge about borrower risk profiles not easily captured by individual features

features.name: repayment_capacity_score
features.description: Composite repayment capacity combining income adequacy, credit score quality, and absence of defaults into a single normalized score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single smooth composite of repayment ability factors; directly useful as a linear projection for SVM decision boundary
